premises.text: Antibiotic overuse drives side effects and antimicrobial resistance, a top global health threat
premises.evidence_span: taking too many antibiotics can pose a danger to our health because of side effects as well as antimicrobial resistance

premises.text: Phages precisely kill target bacteria while sparing beneficial microbes, unlike broad antibiotics
premises.evidence_span: they're natural and they're precise. They're like precise assassins that kill the bad bacteria, but leave the good bacteria alone

premises.text: Precision phage solutions require skin microbiome testing because different patients have different overgrowth organisms beyond C. acnes
premises.evidence_span: if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test. And we were going to need a ton of data

premises.text: Skin Microbiome Discovery Kit with multi-site swabs plus WGS, robotics, and proprietary algorithms profiles microbiome type and informs custom phage serum
premises.evidence_span: Skin Microbiome Discovery Kit and custom phage serums

premises.text: Eight skin microbiome types map to eight phage formulations produced at high titer from large strain biobanks via rapid discovery and screening
premises.evidence_span: Parallel has defined eight different skin microbiome types and formulated eight different formulations. We produce phages by leveraging our biobanks of over 10,000 bacterial phage and fungal strains

premises.text: Skin is the beachhead because dermatologists are the top antibiotic prescribers; platform can later expand across human health
premises.evidence_span: We're starting in skin. Why? Dermatologists are actually the number one prescribers of antibiotics across healthcare

value.text: Precision phage therapy matched to the patient's microbiome instead of broad antibiotics
value.evidence_span: get people off of Accutane and antibiotics
